_comment: Bespoke blocks checked against the page images, so the worklist stops re-listing finished work. A block belongs here only when every row or entry in it was compared field by field against the printed page named. Drift counts for these stay non-zero on purpose: the corpus states this content as structured properties while the book prints a table, so the strings differ from the page even when every value matches.

BOWS.result: 3 rows, no differences; the Unicorn bow is filed under its prose heading, Shinjo Horsebow, not the table's Horsebow

ARMOR_TABLE.result: 9 rows, no differences; qualities within a row run together without commas

CONDITION_DEFINITIONS.result: 16 conditions and both Wounded sub-forms; two clauses restored (Dying stabilizing, Unconscious defending), everything else correct

HERITAGE_TABLE.result: rewritten: nine of ten entries had fabricated sub-tables

TENETS.result: rewritten: three tenets misnamed, two misspelled, seven invented clan attributions

DIFFICULTY_SCALE.result: rewritten: the scale was shifted one step across TN 1-6

USES.result: rewritten: Shattering Parry stated the wrong mechanic

RECOVERY.result: rewritten: an invented once-per-scene limit on adversities

ADVANCEMENT_COSTS.result: rewritten: invented non-curriculum surcharges and an XP price for advantages

QUALITY_DEFINITIONS.result: all 16 qualities, effects and descriptions, no differences

CANCELLING_PAIRS.result: all 6 pairs correct; the sidebar's two other rules are present as comments rather than rules text

TERRAIN_QUALITIES.result: all 6 qualities complete, including the Tainted and Otherworldly clauses and Obscuring's three sight rules

SOCIAL_OBJECTIVES.result: all 4 objectives, completion, achievement and failure conditions, no differences

INVOCATION_OPPORTUNITIES.result: three opportunity costs were half the book's and are corrected; the other 17 rows match

GENERAL_OPPORTUNITIES.result: 18 rows across six elements, no differences

SKILL_OPPORTUNITIES.result: 20 rows across five elements and four skill groups, no differences
